note: K-b gauge U101 (BQ40Z50, QFN-32) turn 0, as on the hand board but 1.9 mm east: VC and SRP/SRN pads face west (cell-input ladder, shunt filter), FET-drive pads (CHG, DSG, PACK, VCC, BAT, FUSE) face north toward the FETs, SMBus pads face east toward U301 and J302, TS and BTP_INT pads face south. Ring 0.8 mm; C105 and C106 may sit at 0.3 mm. Explicit spots computed so no foreign courtyard enters the 1 mm escape zone of a signal pad.
PBI capacitor north-west of U101, PBI pad east toward pin 1
cell-input ladder: C101..C104 stacked so neighbouring pads share a VC net (VC4 | VC3 | VC2 | VC1 | CELL_1N)
100 ohm cell-tap resistors, horizontal, VC pad east at the ladder junction, tap pad west
SRP/SRN filter at the south-west corner of U101
Kelvin series resistors under C106; their far pads (CELL_N, GND) carry the sense pair west to RS101's inner pad edges
band between Q101 and U101: BAT resistor, its diode, PACK and VCC resistors, all horizontal and outside the 1 mm escape zone of the north pads
CELL_P from Q101's east pads round H103 to F102: the planner's outer-layer tree needs this free of signal pads (their 0.4 mm escape room narrows it).
